text:
Elena R.: Quick alert 33a VantageBridge renewal ~6 weeks. Sudden drop in prod usage after their ML lead left. Procurement asked if we're comparable to ForgeX bench. Need triage and short playbook.
Mason K.: Yikes. Do we have route diffs and error/latency signals? Any auth or key churn?
Elena R.: Console clip: 
```
30d active keys: 1,420 -> 420 (-70%)
Top endpoints: /completion (-75%), /bulk-embed (-52%)
Error rate: 0.4% (stable)
p95 lat: 280ms
```
Elena R.: Champion (product analytics) voiced concern but hasn't pushed back yet. New PM onboarding; procurement mentioned ForgeX bench next week.
Connor - CS: Proposed rapid response: brief health call, competitor snapshot focused on ROI, a fast quant + batching perf run on their top prompts, and a short enablement for the new PM. Keep comms tight.
Priya Nair: I'll prep the enablement (45m): integration checklist, cost levers (batching/caching/quant), and rollback plan. Suggest hands-on examples and 3 quick wins.
Mason K.: I'll run a scoped perf job against their top 25 prompts plus a 4-bit quantized variant and batched payloads. Need sample prompts & a small golden set for quality checks. ETA 48-72h.
osps-bot: Created ticket INF-4123: "VantageBridge 33a quant & perf smoke" assigned to Mason K., due in 3 business days.
RevOps: If we propose a short concession, provide ARR impact and approvers. I'll standby.
Elena R.: I'll request sample prompts and schedule the health call for tomorrow EOD. Will CC RevOps + Sales.
Connor - CS: Messaging tip: on the call surface procurement timeline, ask if ForgeX is a full migration or a side-by-side eval, and offer a 2-week cost demo with our quantized config. Keep the ask minimal.
Mason K.: If quant + batching yields ~30% cost down with <4% quality delta on their rubric, that's a solid retention play. I'll include diff examples in the ticket.
Priya Nair: For enablement, bring a short slide deck and two live demos: 1) embedding swap (5 min), 2) batching & cache example (10 min).
Elena R.: Actions & owners:
- Request sample prompts + confirm champion/new PM time (Elena) 44b due today EOD
- Competitor snapshot vs ForgeX (Connor) 44b draft in 48h
- Quant/batching perf run & artifacts (Mason via INF-4123) 44b initial in 72h
- Enablement workshop scheduling + exec nudge (Priya + Elena) 44b schedule by EOD tomorrow
- Renewal concession options & approvers (RevOps) 44b draft in 48h
RevOps: I'll prep scenarios once Mason posts perf delta.
Elena R.: Thanks all. Posting call notes here after the health check. Paste any procurement timeline or bench details into this thread. :pray:
